**Lands in:** `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, the `Claude hook guard self-tests` step comment. Ruled route: **option A** (minimal) — rewrite the dependency sentence to "jq + git, plus whatever each matrix declares in its own header", drop the stale `~2 s` figure, and state that a matrix needing more must declare it in its header. ⛔ Options B/C (a preflight that parses matrix headers) are deferred: one drift instance does not buy a new machine channel (创业阶段不扩散), and B/C would touch `.claude/hooks/**`, a governed surface, for a comment-level defect. Re-open the B route only if a second matrix drifts silently.

Rationale for p3: the drift cannot turn CI red today (the step lives in a job that already has node); the harm is to whoever next moves or slims the step.

Size/model suggestion: S (one comment block), `sonnet`.

## Report

`.github/workflows/lint.yml`'s `Claude hook guard self-tests` step comment
rewritten per triage option A. This continues a killed predecessor's work on
the same card (same PM session, same worktree/branch/PR) — I inherited a clean
tree with the edit and PR already made, re-verified everything against the
current head after merging `origin/main` forward again (it had advanced past
the predecessor's last merge), and confirmed the drift census.

**Before** (`lint.yml:1346-1348`):
> Needs `jq` and `git` and nothing else — no pnpm, no node, no build, no network
> (`jq` is in the runner image and is already relied on bare by cut-rc.yml and
> release.yml). ~2 s measured.

**After:**
> This step itself needs only `jq` and `git` (both in the runner image; `jq` is
> already relied on bare by cut-rc.yml and release.yml), plus whatever each
> discovered matrix declares in its own header — discovery above is by glob, so a
> matrix needing more (node, pnpm, a built tree, a generator) must say so there;
> this comment is not the place to enumerate it.

Stale `~2 s measured` figure dropped. No other line moved: step `name:`, `run:`
script, the `find` discovery, and the rest of the "Hermetic by construction"
paragraph are untouched; the `⚠️ check:step-collectors CANNOT see this block`
admission stays intact. Nothing under `.claude/hooks/**` touched.

**Selftest census** (every `*.selftest.sh` under `.claude/hooks/`, and whether it
calls anything beyond `jq`/`git`/`bash` for real — `node`/`pnpm` strings that
appear only inside simulated Bash-command-string fixtures fed to the guard under
test do NOT count, since the matrix's own header declares its real dependency
set and 4 of the 5 headers say jq+git only despite those literal substrings
appearing in fixture data):

| matrix | own header | real extra deps |
|---|---|---|
| `guard-governed-enqueue.selftest.sh` | "Needs `jq` … and `node`" | **`node`** (real) |
| `guard-main-checkout-bash.selftest.sh` | jq+git only | none |
| `guard-main-checkout.selftest.sh` | jq+git only | none |
| `guard-shared-stash.selftest.sh` | jq only | none |
| `guard-tree-enum.selftest.sh` | jq only | none |

Only the one already-known instance has drifted. No second drifted matrix found,
so route B (a header-parsing preflight) stays deferred per the triage — nothing
to name under `out_of_scope_findings` on that front.
